definitions.explanation: A type of fish cake made from surimi (ground fish paste) that is shaped and deep-fried. A common ingredient in Japanese home cooking, appearing in oden, udon, and as a side dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{揚|あ}げかまぼこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put deep-fried fish cake in the oden.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げかまぼこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Deep-fried fish cake is delicious even eaten as is.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揚|あ}げかまぼこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧、⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I bought two deep-fried fish cakes at the supermarket and put them in udon.

notes:
Composed of {揚|あ}げ (deep-fried) and ⟦かまぼこ→かまぼこ：10307_kamaboko⟧ ({蒲鉾|かまぼこ}, fish cake). The generic term for any deep-fried variety of fish cake.

REGIONAL NAMES:
Called by different names across Japan:
- ⟦さつま{揚|あ}げ→さつま揚げ：07974_satsumaage⟧: the most common name in eastern Japan (originally from Satsuma/Kagoshima)
- ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧: in western Japan, especially Kansai and Kyushu (not to be confused with the battered ⟦{天|てん}ぷら→天ぷら：04948_tenpura⟧ dish)
- ⟦はんぺん→はんぺん：21733_hanpen⟧: in some regions (though {半片|はんぺん} usually refers to a different, softer fish cake)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揚|あ}げかまぼこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill/toast deep-fried fish cake
- ⟦おでん→おでん：14727_oden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{揚|あ}げかまぼこ: deep-fried fish cake in oden
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧{揚|あ}げかまぼこ: homemade deep-fried fish cake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦かまぼこ→かまぼこ：10307_kamaboko⟧ ({蒲鉾|かまぼこ}): fish cake — the general category; usually refers to the steamed variety served on a wooden board
- ⟦さつま{揚|あ}げ→さつま揚げ：07974_satsumaage⟧: fried fish cake — the same product under its Kanto/standard name
- ⟦ちくわ→ちくわ：07479_chikuwa⟧ ({竹輪|ちくわ}): tube-shaped fish cake — a different shape, with a hollow center
- ⟦{練|ね}り{物|もの}→練り物：20035_nerimono⟧: surimi products — the general term for all processed fish paste products
